theme.title: Stockton to Malone
theme.subtitle: Utah Jazz, 1984–2003
theme.recap: John Stockton and Karl Malone played together longer than any teammates, and Stockton barely missed a game.

questions.prompt: In 1989–90 John Stockton set the NBA record for assists per game in a season. What was it?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: As of 2019, Stockton also held the record for assists-per-game average over one season (14.5 in 1990).

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did John Stockton and Karl Malone play together?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The two played a record 1,412 regular season games together as teammates

questions.prompt: Over 19 seasons, how many games did John Stockton miss?
questions.note: Just 22. He played every game in 17 seasons.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: missing only 22 games in his 19-season career and playing every game of 17 seasons
